description: Source code for a Python module that implements a tracing system for function calls with remote logging capabilities, including decorators, trace functions, and asynchronous HTTP requests.

classes.name: Tracer
classes.description: A class that provides methods for tracing function calls, capturing arguments, serializing variables, and sending trace logs to a remote server.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Tracer with repository URL and optional server base URL.

methods.name: trace_endpoint
methods.description: Decorator to wrap functions for tracing their calls and results.

methods.name: _send_trace_log
methods.description: Asynchronously sends the trace context to a remote endpoint or saves locally in development mode.

methods.name: _serialize_variable
methods.description: Serializes a variable to JSON-compatible format, handling exceptions.

methods.name: _get_file_tag
methods.description: Determines if a file is from standard library, external library, or internal code based on path.

methods.name: _setup_trace
methods.description: Sets up the tracing function with context.

methods.name: _capture_arguments
methods.description: Captures and serializes function arguments from a frame.

methods.name: _trace_function_calls
methods.description: Main trace function that logs call, return, and exception events with relevant data.
